node.title: L1 intrinsic partial-core triple-polarity closure
node.statement: For an intrinsic quotient partition, allow an arbitrary (k-1)-point source core and measure three symmetric exception counts: layout polarity of the core against complete fibers, exact-defect polarity inside each core slice, and petal-support polarity. Four orientation vectors over L=n/ell fibers, bounded exception sets, source-member uniqueness, and the whole-strip CRT bounds give at most (log_2 n+1)(R_0+1)(B_0+1)(P_0+1)n^(4/c_0+R_0+B_0+P_0+2 gamma P_0) contributors across all intrinsic scales. Thus every fixed triple-polarity box is globally polynomial even with partial cores; non-intrinsic quotient maps and arbitrary petals remain open.
